expectedBy.model: dsh TypeScript client (session-controller client + gateway journal) and conversation engine (ui-conversation + ui-chat)
realClasses: inbox, message, developer-message, system-message, request-prompt, assistant, tool, turn-error, turn-max-tokens, turn-tail, model-retry, command, compaction and turn-process Definitions, unknown-surface fallback and the chat snapshot builder (ui-chat)
glue: fake SessionRemotes: session.follow yields the fixture frames per connection generation, session.page answers recorded pages matched on (address, throughSeq, beforeSeq), $stream builds the real RemoteStream over a fake connection handle
step driver, settle loop and snapshot encoder

module resolution: dsh tsconfig paths via tsx, zustand/immer from the vector-node install
